title: Cellar and Portrait
author: Isandro Dravenmoor
blurb: Bram Hartwell, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must finish the ritual the founders started before the harvest moon rises.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
